text: 【潘功胜：地缘政治冲突加剧仍是全球经济的最大不确定性】中国人民银行行长潘功胜15日在出席二十国集团（G20）财长和央行行长会议时表示，地缘政治冲突加剧仍是全球经济的最大不确定性。各方应充分用好G20财金合作平台，强化宏观经济政策协同，携手应对全球性风险挑战。
text_en: [Pan Gongsheng: Intensifying geopolitical conflicts remain the biggest uncertainty for the global economy] PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng said on the 15th while attending the G20 Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors Meeting that intensifying geopolitical conflicts remain the biggest uncertainty for the global economy. All parties should make full use of the G20 finance and financial cooperation platform, strengthen macroeconomic policy coordination, and work together to address global risks and challenges.
